summary.intent: Implement SDK client self-bootstrap of folder tree from root IPNS key, eliminating the web-side pre-seeding requirement that caused 'Folder not loaded' errors after reloads.
summary.outcome: Full implementation shipped and pushed: added `rootIpnsKeypair` to `CipherBoxClientConfig`, implemented `ensureFolderLoaded` DFS walk with corrupt-sibling resilience, wired a `requireFolder` chokepoint into all 11 folderTree-dependent mutation sites, added 7-case unit test and reload-restore E2E spec, and fixed the concrete bin-restore-after-reload bug. 179 SDK tests pass, typecheck clean, lint clean.

repo: `CipherBoxClientConfig` (types.ts:44-88) carried `rootIpnsName` + `rootFolderKey` but never the root IPNS Ed25519 signing keypair — it existed in `vaultStore.rootIpnsKeypair` (guarded at useAuth.ts:281) but was never passed to the SDK.

`FolderState` (types.ts:96-111) holds the per-folder IPNS signing keypair (`ipnsKeypair`) and AES-256 `folderKey`; `registerFolder` (client.ts:288) and `loadFolder` (client.ts:345) are the only two entry points that create folderTree entries — both require the caller to supply the keypair.
Child `FolderEntry` records carry hex-encoded `folderKeyEncrypted` + `ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted` unwrapped via `unwrapKey` (ECIES) from `@cipherbox/crypto`, which also exports `hexToBytes`.
`withOperation` is reentrant-safe (emits lifecycle events only, no lock), so calling it from inside `ensureFolderLoaded` which itself is called from within a `withOperation` block is safe.
Integration tests in `integration.test.ts` use `describe.skip` when `CI` env var is set — they need a live backend at localhost:3000; running `CI=1` surfaces the true unit-test pass count.
`pnpm typecheck` at the repo root rebuilds the full dependency chain before running `tsc -b` on the web app — required after any public-API change to the SDK package.
The `recycle-bin.spec.ts` E2E suite never reloads between operations, so it missed the bin-restore-after-reload failure class; `full-workflow.spec.ts:536-575` is the reference for the reload pattern.

code.finding: CipherBoxClientConfig — full field inventory; missing root IPNS keypair was the root cause of the bootstrap gap
FolderState type — includes ipnsKeypair (Ed25519) and folderKey (AES-256); no parent pointer, tree linkage is implicit via children array
registerFolder — synchronous entry point that builds FolderState with metadata:null; requires caller-supplied keypair
loadFolder — async entry point that fetches IPNS metadata and builds full FolderState; also requires caller-supplied keypair
restoreFromBin delegates to binOps passing this.folderTree with no pre-seeding — confirmed root of the bin-restore-after-reload bug
rootIpnsKeypair null guard existed but the value was never forwarded to SDK config — the missing wire

workflow: Spawning a 5-agent parallel code-mapping workflow before implementing on a complex multi-file feature was high ROI — prevented misreading the type hierarchy (FolderEntry vs FolderState) and identified the exact thrower sites up front.
Running an adversarial security review agent before committing crypto/key-handling changes caught the corrupt-sibling abort risk (hardened to skip+continue before commit).

The `/simplify` 4-parallel-agent pattern identified the `requireFolder` chokepoint refactor that collapsed 11 repeated `get ?? ensureFolderLoaded ?? throw` patterns — this class of drift (#494) is easy to miss without a dedicated reuse pass.
Checking `git diff @{upstream}...HEAD` as the diff source for `/simplify` gave it exactly the right scope (branch delta only, not full repo).

friction: Initial `ensureFolderLoaded` implementation caused type errors at createFolder (lines 435, 472) — `let root` typed `FolderState | undefined` from `.get()` conflicted with `loadFolder` returning `| null`; required a follow-up coalesce edit.
Two prettier formatting nits (line-wrap) required a separate auto-fix pass after both the implementation commit and the simplify commit.
Integration test failures initially looked like regressions until confirmed pre-existing — the `describe.skip` CI guard wasn't obvious without reading the test file.
open_items: Remove ~16 web-side `ensureFolderRegistered` call sites — now redundant no-ops since the SDK self-heals, but left to avoid widening this PR's blast radius; safe follow-up after self-bootstrap proves in prod.
No negative-cache in `ensureFolderLoaded` — an unreachable target re-walks the full tree on every call; add a Set of attempted-but-not-found ipnsNames to short-circuit repeated failed walks.
DFS parallelization of sibling folder loads in `ensureFolderLoaded` — skipped because it loses early-exit and over-fetches IPNS; could revisit if vault startup latency becomes a concern.
Extract shared IPNS unwrap helper between web and SDK (both duplicate the `hexToBytes` + `unwrapKey` + `FolderState` construction pattern); cross-package scope deferred.
